fees.note: Fees are dated data; changes are announced in advance and never apply to orders already placed.

steps.title: Five steps to start selling
steps.registerText: Email and seller type: company, household or individual business.
steps.kycText: Through VNeID or documents, checked by an eKYC partner. Required before listing.
steps.termsText: The {name} operating rules and seller agreement, versioned.
steps.shopText: Name, description, pickup address, payout account (only the last 4 digits are shown back).
steps.reviewText: Within 2 working days; products are reviewed before they appear.

requirements.title: What you need
requirements.kyc: Citizen ID of the household head, individual or legal representative.
requirements.license: Business or household business registration (if any) and tax code.
requirements.conditional: Conditional goods (food, cosmetics…) need category documents; prohibited goods cannot be listed.
requirements.bank: A bank account in the seller’s name to receive payouts.
requirements.law: Under e-commerce rules, sellers must be verified before listing (2025 E-commerce Law, Decree 117/2025/ND-CP — check the original texts).

faq.title: Quick answers
faq.payoutAnswer: Buyers pay into the payment partner’s collection account. After the 7-day return period, the partner pays you in the weekly payout, minus marketplace fees and any withheld tax. {name} never holds the money.
faq.taxAnswer: Companies file their own taxes. For household and individual businesses, the marketplace withholds VAT and personal income tax when paying out and issues a withholding certificate (Decree 117/2025/ND-CP — check the original text).
faq.codAnswer: The courier collects on delivery and remits to the partner’s collection account, not the marketplace’s; you are then paid like a prepaid order.
faq.dispute: What if there is a dispute?
faq.disputeAnswer: You have 48 hours to answer the buyer. If you cannot agree, the marketplace decides based on photos, both sides’ statements and the order history.

form.title: Apply to sell
form.closed: This form is closed for now.
form.sampleSent: Sample: the application is not stored. The real version emails a seller sign-up link to {email} (valid 7 days); the next step is identity verification.
form.consent: I agree that the marketplace uses this email and information to review my application (not for advertising).
form.after: We email you a link to create the seller account.
